synthetic_status: All music parameters and scenarios are simulated inputs to a synthetic educational model. They describe software configuration, not a delivered clinical intervention, and do not establish therapeutic effectiveness.
enforced_by: The Pydantic schema in src/ai_music_therapy/models.py (MusicParameters, TrialRecord) is the runtime-enforced source of truth for these allowed values; this file is the human- and machine-readable declaration, kept consistent by tests/test_models.py.

genre.description: Broad musical character of the simulated stimulus.

bpm.description: Simulated tempo; bounded to a calm-to-moderate range for this educational model.

volume.description: Ordinal simulated loudness; 'high' triggers an explicit caution flag.

tonality.description: Simulated pitch organization; 'atonal' can increase the simulated abruptness signal.

lyrics_language.description: Whether simulated lyrics are present and their language; non-'none' adds a simulated cognitive-load signal.

scenarios.label: Sleep support
scenarios.favorable_direction: lower simulated anxiety and higher simulated regulation/mood.
scenarios.rubric: A favorable software outcome is lower simulated anxiety together with higher simulated regulation and mood across the start/middle/end stages. This is a descriptive software rubric, not a sleep-quality or clinical measure.
stop_conditions: If simulated anxiety_level >= 8, display the high-simulated-distress stop-condition flag and offer a stop control.
If volume is 'high', display the explicit high-volume caution flag.
scenarios.clinical_note: Software outcome only; not a validated measure of sleep and not a treatment for sleep disturbance.

scenarios.label: Anxiety support
scenarios.favorable_direction: lower simulated anxiety and higher simulated regulation/mood.
scenarios.rubric: A favorable software outcome is a reduction in simulated anxiety with stable or improved regulation and mood. The rubric reads model-generated signals only; it does not measure real anxiety.
stop_conditions: If simulated anxiety_level >= 8, display the high-simulated-distress stop-condition flag and offer a stop control.
If volume is 'high', display the explicit high-volume caution flag.
scenarios.clinical_note: Software outcome only; not a validated anxiety measure and not an anxiety treatment.

scenarios.label: Focus support
scenarios.favorable_direction: higher simulated engagement and longer simulated attention.
scenarios.rubric: A favorable software outcome is higher simulated engagement and longer simulated attention alongside adequate regulation. This describes simulated attention to a stimulus, not a clinical measure of attention.
stop_conditions: If simulated anxiety_level >= 8, display the high-simulated-distress stop-condition flag and offer a stop control.
If volume is 'high', display the explicit high-volume caution flag.
scenarios.clinical_note: Software outcome only; not a validated measure of attention or focus and not a treatment for attention-related conditions.

scenarios.label: Engagement support
scenarios.favorable_direction: higher simulated engagement and mood, with richer simulated communication observations.
scenarios.rubric: A favorable software outcome is higher simulated engagement and mood and more varied simulated communication observations. The observations are model-generated text constrained by the persona's listed modes, not real behavior.
stop_conditions: If simulated anxiety_level >= 8, display the high-simulated-distress stop-condition flag and offer a stop control.
If volume is 'high', display the explicit high-volume caution flag.
scenarios.clinical_note: Software outcome only; not a validated measure of social engagement or communication and not a communication intervention.

scenarios.label: Regulation support
scenarios.favorable_direction: higher simulated regulation and mood, and lower simulated anxiety.
scenarios.rubric: A favorable software outcome is higher simulated regulation and mood with lower simulated anxiety, indicating simulated recovery/co-regulation. This is a constructed descriptive index, not a validated regulation measure.
stop_conditions: If simulated anxiety_level >= 8, display the high-simulated-distress stop-condition flag and offer a stop control.
If volume is 'high', display the explicit high-volume caution flag.
scenarios.clinical_note: Software outcome only; not a validated measure of emotional regulation and not a treatment for dysregulation.

outcome_dimensions.description: ReactionOutput fields used as descriptive software signals, not clinical instruments.

anxiety_level.meaning: Simulated anxiety signal; higher means more simulated distress.

engagement_level.meaning: Simulated engagement with the stimulus; higher means more simulated engagement.

mood_score.meaning: Simulated mood signal; higher means a more favorable simulated mood.

regulation_score.meaning: Simulated regulation/co-regulation signal; higher means better simulated regulation.

attention_duration_sec.meaning: Simulated sustained attention to the stimulus in seconds.

outcome_dimensions.clinical_note: These are researcher-defined descriptive indices constructed from synthetic profiles and music parameters. They are not validated clinical instruments and must not be reported as clinical evidence.
